# The OS-specific spellings this repository still ships in a card template, one
# `file:line spell date reason` per row. A card template is handed to a worker
# verbatim and the estate is mixed (linux: hulk, vision, space, mini; darwin: the
# Studio, the Air), so a GNU-only or Mac-only command here is a card that dies on
# the first bench of the other kind. Every row is checked in BOTH directions: a
# spelling not listed is a red run, and a listed spelling that has left is a stale
# row and also a red run. This list only ever shrinks.
#
# Empty today (2026-09-18): no shipped card template names a command only one
# platform has.
